findings.claim: NamedTuple field docstring stacks undefined terms ('sticky-selected', 'body-height units', 'shipped') with no explanation of what they mean.
findings.quote: :param carry_ratio: (t,) shuttle-to-nearest sticky-selected player's nearer-WRIST distance divided by that player's bbox height (body-height units); NaN where the shuttle is invisible or no sticky pick has a finite height. findings.quote: A visible sample there with image-y within TOP_EDGE_FRAC of 0 means the shuttle left the frame upward (a lob) and will fall back into view; a non-visible or non-top sample reads False.

findings.claim: Docstring is bulky with nested clauses in a single 14-line paragraph; breaks the single-thought-per-paragraph rule.
findings.quote: A sustained-loss gap does NOT close the window when the last visible sample before it sits at the frame top: the shuttle lobbed out of the top of the picture and will descend back into view, so the search waits for the re-entry, still bounded by the next serve and the replay mask (and by any LATER sustained-loss gap that did not follow a top exit).

findings.claim: Inline comment is long (4 sentences) with multiple clauses, violating single-thought-per-sentence rule and making it hard to extract the invariant.
findings.quote: Ankle refinement: a static frame whose shuttle is nearer an ankle than a wrist is resting on the ground by the feet, not paused in a hand, so the held carve-out must not veto it. A standing player sits ~0.5 box-heights from a grounded shuttle's nearest wrist (reads as held) but nearer its ankle; without this the settle cap never fires on such a rest.
